book.title: Maak Yesu Ye Weng Amun Maakbed Wongkoon

content: Yesu Ye Kambongdan Kuu Ye Yaa Kubindo
Kwane, Yesu kuu kuyaa koronde ye kedmengkandeendan be ye kainoon ye kambong yaa be wonoon.

Kwane, Sabat aron keruune, kurikuri ambiwoombed andowe kedmengkandoone, yemoon kuu wengamberenekorib binangkiwen. Binangkekorib, yikareb kaamoniwen, “Karub kee, kedmengkandi kee kunambed boon? Inamen mengmeng kara kee kanembed konoonkob, God yaromkono wedmi yeman kuu ongmimaan kii!
Ye kuu no ambib yenbi ye karub kuda! Ye kuu Meri yu dana, Yems yoom Yosef yoom Yudas yoom Saimon yoom yi aagorok kedi! Ye yangkura kuu nub yoom keyaa doruuwa!” andekorib, ye yaa kongeniwen.
Yesumbed yi yaa yedmoon, “Profesiman kuu yemoonbed karub amun andimaib kumban, ye kambongdaniib ye karubkimiib ye ambanga damana aweneyiib kumbedmo ye yaa karub amun andimokban.” andoon.
Kowe, ye kuu God yaromkono wedmi yeman kuu ye kambong kumaom ma korokbindo. Bob anikaddan mimim kumbedmo arimo ye dingkimbed ari kowe ongmoone amun keriwen.
Kwane ye kuu binangkoon, yi kuu ye yaa anam andindo kowe. Yesumbed Wad Ayoob Yedmoone Ye Wengiib Kanwiniwen (Mt 10:1-14, Lk 9:1-5) Kwane, Yesu kuu wene kambong kambong yaa kedmengkandenmo yaroon.
Kedmengkandeendan wad ayoob kuu yedmoone, ye yaamo keriiwe, awad arewa yenburi yaromkonoyiib kondene ayoob ayoob nekwoon kuu wenebe weng amun dakmi ye dowad.
Nekwekore, yembed kwamunime andi ye weng daandoon, “Yiribmaniib ma be wanaib, kungkang atmo. Omiibban meniibban odiibban, kui.
Yonkad deebime kumban ebkad maayiib maandaib.
Kambong maa aomnibko, karub maambed nambiwoom miniiwo doberem andoonka, kwane kuyaom dobirime. Doberenib kumbed wene kambong kuyaom domondi yaron keraneen, ambib maa yaa wene dobaraib.

Kambong maa aomnibko, yiib yaa kubendokban kere wengamberendokban keribka, yiib yon dabderem yiri ingkud kuu wangkibko kiroboko koronde winime. Kwananiib kuu yi inamen arewa kuu yika akmi ye dowad.” andoon.
Kwane daandoone, yi kuu wenebe nimakarub yaa ambarakmi yaa kuu koronde amonombime ande kedmengkandiwen.
Kedmengkandenib, yimbed awad arewa yemoon yenburenib, bob anikaddan yemoon kuu yi korok ari olif yob ambod ok amun kerundi yeman kumbed bunabende kurikuri keriiwe, God yaromkonombed amun keriwen.
Yoon Baptaisman Ye Korok Wandiwen

Yesu ye weng yirin daande wuneen kowe, King Erod kangkon wengamboroon. Yenambed dakmiwen, “Ye kuu Yoon Baptaisman bobnoon yirimbed demboon kii. Kwanekob God yaromkono wedmi yeman korokbimaan.” andiwen.
Kwanandiwen kumban, yenambed yedmiwen, “Ye kuu Elaidya kii!” andiwen. Kumban yenambed dakmiwen kuu “Ye kuu profesiman maa, kurin anuk yiri doriib kwamune areb kii!” andiwen.
Kwane dakmimaib kowe, Erod kuu wengamberekore yedmoon, “Ye kuu nembed Yoon ye korok wandaane bobnoon kumbed demboon kii!” andoon.

Anuk yiri kuu King Erod yembed kwanime andi ye weng kondoonkob, Yoon kuu awinene nong yengbe kanwene wii aom kowiwen. Yembed kwanoon amborom kuu ye aagorok Filip ye wonong Erodiasbed yu ambi dankare domonenuune Erodbed yu kuu awanoon kumbed
Yoonbed Erod yaa yedmimaan, “Eb aagorok ye wonong awani kuu amob! Eb aagorok bobnindo kowe.” andoon.
Kwaniiwe, Erodiasbed Yoon yaa arud wandunekoru ayande kameen kumban, yu kuu kwanindeban,

amborom kuu Yoon kuu inamen yorokmo awinene karadmo ye karub kowe, Erod kuu unekore Erodias yu arud kuu kebende ye oonoon. Erod kuu Yoon ye weng wengamberene ne kiwaaniibban ee ande kirinwimaan kumban ye dowaken ye yaa wengambarande kamimaan.

Amaanbed, King Erod ye wooneen yaron ani orok ani yeman yaron muneen kowe, Erodiasbed kibikee ne aron kii ande meeneen. Erod ye korok korok darewoowiib ana nangmidan yi korok korokiib Galelidan yi korok korokiib kuu yambiwoom animanbon kowoon yaamo keriwen.

Kwaniiwe, Erodias yu mungkan kuu mene awuderenu ebkad wayirikni andi andeen. Kwaneen kuu Erod yoom ye owod mene animan aniibdan yoom kuu kubiwen. Kwane, King Erodbed wonong koyu kuyaa yedmendoon, “Kub dowakenmo, komo ne yaa kuu kaamowebko nembed kub yaa kabda.” andoon.
Andekore yu yaa wiim aangki areb yedme kowoon, “Komo kaamonaneeb kuu kabdeni, nembed oonaan yambibkin kangkon andokbe angkara kuu kub kabdaniin.” andoon.
Andoone, yu kuu yi domonde wene yu awaan yaa kaamondeen, “Ne kuu komo kawok andaniin kii?” anduune, awaanbed inande yedmeen, “Yoon Baptaisman ye korok kii.” andeen.
Kwananduune, kirodmo koyu kuu wengiib king yaa kanwene yedmeen, “Ne dowaken kuu kibirebyamo Yoon Baptaisman ye korok kuu yabad arimbed kowe kawe.” andeen.
Anduune, King Erod kuu ye inamen aom kuu yiminban darewoob keroon kumban, ye wiim aangkiyiib ye yoom aniwen kuu ye weng wengambiriweniib kuyaambed yu weng wengamberedandi kuu yiminban keroon.
Kowe kwane yembed korok wi ye karub yaa daanoon, “Wene Yoon ye korok wanmene.” andoone, wene wii aombed Yoon ye korok kuu naroon.
Narekore, korok kuu yabad arimbed kanmonoone kande koyu yaa kondoone, yumbed kanwene yu awaan yaa kondeen.
Kwane, Yoon ye kedmengkandidan kuu weng kee wengamberekorib, ye id kuu kanwene bobkonombon ye botdem aom kowe mangkiwen.
Yesumbed 5,000iib Animan Bangkandoon
Apasodan kuu wenebekorib, Yesu yaa ika mene awanewandenib, yimbed komarewa kamenib kedmengkandiwen kuu ye yaa daaniwen.
Kwane, nimakarub yemoon kuu mene wene kamiib kowe, yi kuu animan anindeban. Kwani kowe, yembed yi yaa yedmoon, “Yiibbedmo ne yaa minibko wene kuweng aweneyiibban yaambed dibere yiidkem.” andoon.
Andoone, yimbedmo parai motod aombed wene obonmo yaa andowe winiwen.
Kumban motod aom awuniiwe, yemoon kuu wedmendekorib yi kuu yikaadkeriwen kowe, taundan kuu yonka kabaanmo wene Yesu awene wanandamiib yaa yidin wene kuyaa doriib.

Kwane, Yesu awene kuu wene wirinekoriwa, Yesu kuu kadaareb kuu wedmendekore, yi yaa mimyob keendoon, amborom kuu yi kuu sibi areb kumban ooni ye karuwiibban areb. Kowe, yembed weng yemoon kedmengkandoon.
Wene oobnone, ye kedmengkandeendan mene ye yaa yedmiwen, “Keyaa kuu obonmo kambongiibban, angkon miriknandameen kii!
Kowe, nimakarub kee yedmendebko, wenebenib awanewandeen ye okad angkayiib kambong kambong yaa wenebe yikareb animan berengkanan anime.” andiwen.

Kumban yembed yedmoon, “Yiibbed animan bangkandibko anime.” andoon. Kwanandoone, yimbed ye yaa yedmeniwen, “Nimakarub korem yi animan berengkanuub kuu od darewoob kii! Od kuu wood kaningkaningiib deme ye kakman areb kii! Nub kuu wene kwamune animan kuu berengkane bangkandanuubkob ananiib dee? Yiminban oi!” andiwen.
Kwanandiiwe, yembed kaamondoon, “Yiib kuu om komoyiib? Wene wedmime.” andoon. Kwane wene wedmekorib, yimbed yedmiwen, “Om angkoyiib okyiri oon ayoowiib kii.” andiwen.
Kwane, Yesumbed nimakarub yaa yedmoon, “Wadbed nekwane kereek ari dibirime.” andoon.
Andoone, yi kuu yikareb nekwane wad mimo kuu 100iib kere wad maa kuu 50yiib kere kwamune nekwanmo wene dibiriwen.

Kwaniiwe, yembed om angkoyiib oon ayoowiib kuu bene ambid ari wedmene God yaa eso andekore, omiib ooniib kuu domangkoon. Kwanekore, ye kedmengkandeendan yedmoone, nimakarub yaa benbangkandenmo yariwen.
Yi korem kuu ane mikmoniwen.
Anekoriwa, ye kedmengkandeendanbed omiib ooniib dungkun dungkun kuu ben kabed aom kambungke dewene kabed wad ayoowiib kuu ambonmo wire wonoon.
Nimakarub korem animan aniwen kuu karub 5,000iib.
Yesu Ok Animari Dodkanmo Wonoon
Kwane kuyaambed Yesu kuu ye kedmengkandeendan yaa yedmoon, “Motodbed Betsaida yaa yiibdin yanime.” andoone winiiwe, angkon kadaareb yaa ika winime ande yedmekore domondoon.
Kwane domondekore, aangko ari wene kurikuri kerok wonoon.
Kwane miriknoone, ye kedmengkandeendan kuu motodiib bowan wedangka domenmo weniib. Yesu kuu bid yaa yembirimo keroon.

Kowe, ye kedmengkandeendan kuu wedmendoone, ud yaa yobdoodmo awingke dongmenabiwen, amborom kuu nuubbed yi yaa naawonmo dedmonoon kowe. Amnoom warewini yaambed yiyiib yaa bowan animarimbed dodkanmo wonoon. Wene yi kuu burudandokandoon

kumban, yi kuu ye wedmeniiwe ok animari dodkanmo meneene, yimbed meeniwen kuu ye kuu awad manok ande unekorib komkiwen. Kwane kuyaambed, yi yaa daandoon, “Nembed kei, yiib unaib, yiib niindem aom aromnime.” andoon.
Kwanekore, yiyiib yaa motod aom aomnoone nuub kuu dowan keroon. Kwanoone yi kuu binangki darewoob keriwen,
amborom kuu yi kuu omdini aniwen ye weng id anam kandindo, yi mimyob kuu kebeniwen kowe.
Bob Anikaddan Ongmenaboon
Kwane, yara yane bidambib Genesaret yaa wirine kuyaa motod nong boroniwen.
Kwane kuyaambed, nimakarub kuu Yesu wedme yikaadkeriwen
kowe, kabaanmo wene ambibkin kuyaom bob anikaddan korem yi did arimbed be kunaya winimaan yaa be minimaib.

Yesu kunaya winimaan, kambong aom o taun aom o ambibkin angka o kunaya winimaan kuu bob anikaddan kuu yenambed be mene kambong wedya nongkobimaib. Kwane yi kuu badmendok ande eekmimaib, yebkad doboob dungkun yaa kangkon, korem kane kanembed ye yaa badmeniwen kuu amun keriwen.
